input.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.242% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents an improvement over the baseline F2 configuration (5 mm, 3.2% resolution) and significantly outperforms the other candidate materials: F1 achieves 3.753% at 4 mm and F3 achieves 5.098% at 6 mm. All three materials meet the radiation safety constraint with residual dose rates below 20 µSv/h after one week of cooldown. The 4 mm thickness falls within the required 2-10 mm range and represents the optimal balance for electromagnetic shower development in the F2 material, providing superior sampling frequency and energy measurement precision for the forward calorimeter.
